messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@nexsume.com>
Cc: procurement@nexsume.com
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Inference cost discovery & proposed action plan

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and the three asks we agreed on so we stay aligned.

Summary of pain / objectives
- Primary pain: unpredictable inference cost when model usage spikes (peak batch of account verification flows during payroll runs).
- Business goal: move from POC to a predictable production rollout with <15% token cost variance month-over-month and sub-200ms 95th percentile latency for small prompts.
- Constraints: current procurement cap is $60k Q3, security requires SOC2 evidence, and SRE wants dedicated routing to avoid cross-tenant contention.

Key technical levers we discussed
- Batching: 40–80 prompt batching in non-interactive flows — expect ~3–4x throughput improvement in CPU/GPU utilization.
- KV/prefix caching: reuse session KV for repeated account lookups to cut token count on later prompts by ~30%.
- Model variant routing: fall back to a quantized 8-bit variant for low-value requests to control token cost without major quality regression.

Proposed action items (next 7 days)
1) Redwood: send a short TCO one-pager with sample run-rate scenarios and a conservative and aggressive savings case. (Attachment A) — due Tue 5/18.
2) Nexsume: share a week of anonymized traffic profile (payload sizes, peak QPS windows, prompt length distributions). Procurement can redact PII — due Fri 5/21.
3) Joint: set a 30-min follow-up to review the scenarios and confirm target SLA and budget envelope (you suggested Wed 5/19 afternoon).

Immediate ask: can you confirm whether the $60k cap is for hosting-only or is it intended to include integration/engineering services? That affects our recommended reserved capacity sizing.

Attachments: Redwood_TCO_one-pager.pdf (1 page) — quick run-rate tables and two sample batching scenarios.

Thanks — talk soon.

Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

- $60k is the total quarterly budget we can pull for third-party hosting and any recurring infra costs; professional services should be scoped separately and we have a small pool for that but it needs explicit approval.

I'll loop in procurement separately if we need an early MSA draft.
